recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結切片中，淡粉紅色、細胞質豐富的腫瘤細胞巢佔據被膜下竇（subcapsular sinus）並向內取代實質，將殘存的深藍色淋巴組織與濾泡擠在中間，是轉移性癌（metastatic carcinoma）的典型分佈。
features: Pale eosinophilic sheets and nests of cohesive tumor cells within the subcapsular and intranodal sinuses
Tumor partially replacing the nodal parenchyma, separating residual dark-blue lymphoid areas
Residual lymphoid follicle with a germinal center
Intact capsule with perinodal adipose tissue at the bottom
Cytologic detail of tumor cells not assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows pale eosinophilic nests and sheets of cohesive cells filling the subcapsular and intranodal sinuses and extending into the parenchyma, with residual dark-staining lymphoid tissue and a follicle with a germinal center in between. The capsule is present with perinodal fat below. The sinusoidal distribution of a foreign cohesive population is typical of metastatic spread via afferent lymphatics, although tumor cytology cannot be evaluated at this power. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma to lymph node; cytokeratin immunostaining would confirm epithelial origin.

ddx.vs: Sinus histiocytosis contains bland, discohesive histiocytes that are CD68/CD163-positive and cytokeratin-negative.
ALCL cells are CD30+, often ALK+ and cytokeratin-negative, with hallmark kidney-shaped nuclei.
Melanoma can form sinusoidal nests but is S100/SOX10/HMB-45-positive and cytokeratin-negative, sometimes with pigment.
